title: V92 Ground Effect World Coordinate Snapshot Fix
changes: GROUND_CELL and GROUND_SPAWN capture target-foot world coordinates when the event fires.
Acidified Zone Water/Earth/Wind target-side START/BOTTOM/MAIN/HIT visuals use a ground world snapshot.
Caster buffs remain live on the player; normal target effects remain live on the monster; projectile endpoints remain live.
Saved world positions are reprojected through the current camera each frame and do not inherit player-relative offsets.
preserved: 55 active skill effects / 454 deployed effects and passive gate
refine risk warning, fixed fly, boss escape, death UI, converters
testTargets: Cast Acidified Zone on a monster, then move the player: effect stays at the original monster-ground point.
Move the monster after the ground burst starts: the saved ground layers do not follow it.
Use a buff: its visual still follows the player.
Use a projectile: it still travels from the live player to the live target.
